_comment: Canonical 18Dragon train data master. Tool-agnostic source for the train cards (tools/gen-train-cards.mjs). Roster matches base 1822 (see CLAUDE.md / 18dragon.json). 'deck' trains are physical deck cards; 'deck:false' trains render only on their private card backs (2P/LP/5P/P+). phase_color is the 18xx tile tier (yellow/green/brown/gray) used for the numeral + banner.

schema.name: Train label shown as the big numeral (L, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, E, 2P, LP, 5P, P+).
schema.phase_color: 18xx tile tier for the numeral/banner: yellow | green | brown | gray.
schema.cost: Purchase price in gp (0 = prize / not purchased).
schema.rust: Label of the train that rusts this one (null if permanent).
schema.rust_color: Tier color of the rusting train, for the RUSTED BY banner.
schema.permanent: true => gold PERMANENT banner instead of RUSTED BY.
schema.deck: true = a deck card; false = rendered only as a private back.
schema.back: For a two-sided deck card, the reverse face (L's back is the 2).
schema.on_private: For deck:false trains, the private id(s) whose back this is.
schema.note: Small extra line on the card.
